title: Mario's glove seen on the shiny floor of the craft
place_text: Aboard craft, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I was lying down somewhere and there was a glove on a floor, a real shiny floor, nothing like the inside of that truck.

plain: An Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson says that in 1977, after a night in the missile fields around Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he remembers lying down somewhere and seeing a glove on "a real shiny floor, nothing like the inside of that truck." He tells it as his own memory of being aboard a craft. The glove, he suggests, was the one his fellow airman Mario Woods later found missing, which would tie both men's accounts to the same place.
